description: Parkings - Ville de Dijon is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Polygons representing the surface car parks, structures and relay car parks of the City of Dijon. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Parkings - City of Dijon" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include voies, stationnement, wfs/wms, transport, véhicules, parking. The listing shows 2017-09-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
